headers.name: actual_opened_cuts_noninterlacing
headers.header:
theorem actual_opened_cuts_noninterlacing
    (face : TaxonOuterFace D N.leaf)
    (hnt : ∃ u v : BlobVertex N.graph b, u≠v) :
    ∃ C : Set Schoenflies.Plane, IsJordanCurve C ∧
      Function.Injective (tipPoint N D b hg hb) ∧
      (∀ t : (M).OpenedTip, tipPoint N D b hg hb t∈C) ∧
      ∀ (f : (M).OpenedHybridEdge) (a c d e : (M).OpenedTip), a≠c → d≠e →
        (OG).OrientedQuartet f ((M).openedTipVertex a) ((M).openedTipVertex c)
          ((M).openedTipVertex d) ((M).openedTipVertex e) →
        ∀ A₁ A₂ : Set Schoenflies.Plane,
          IsCutPair C (tipPoint N D b hg hb a) (tipPoint N D b hg hb c) A₁ A₂ →
          ¬(tipPoint N D b hg hb d∈A₁ ∧ tipPoint N D b hg hb e∈A₂)

headers.name: proper_crosscut_closed_cells
headers.header:
theorem proper_crosscut_closed_cells
    {C P A₁ A₂ : Set Plane} {p q : Plane}
    (hC : IsJordanCurve C) (hcut : IsCutPair C p q A₁ A₂)
    (hP : IsArcBetween P p q) (hPC : P ∩ C = {p,q})
    (hPD : P \ {p,q} ⊆ inside C) :
    ∃ F₁ F₂ : Set Plane, IsClosed F₁ ∧ IsClosed F₂ ∧
      F₁ ∪ F₂ = C ∪ inside C ∧ F₁ ∩ F₂ = P ∧
      F₁ ∩ C = A₁ ∧ F₂ ∩ C = A₂

headers.name: proper_crosscut_blocks_connected
headers.header:
theorem proper_crosscut_blocks_connected
    {C P Q A₁ A₂ : Set Plane} {p q r s : Plane}
    (hC : IsJordanCurve C) (hcut : IsCutPair C p q A₁ A₂)
    (hP : IsArcBetween P p q) (hPC : P ∩ C = {p,q})
    (hPD : P \ {p,q} ⊆ inside C)
    (hQ : IsPreconnected Q) (hQdisk : Q ⊆ C ∪ inside C)
    (hdisj : Disjoint Q P) (hrQ : r∈Q) (hsQ : s∈Q)
    (hr : r∈A₁) (hs : s∈A₂) : False

headers.name: ambient_to_model
closed_disk_carrier_proper_arc
headers.header:
theorem closed_disk_carrier_proper_arc
    {C P K : Set Plane} {p q : Plane}
    (hC : IsJordanCurve C) (hP : IsCompact P) (hPc : IsPreconnected P)
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hPK : Disjoint P K)
    (hPdisk : P ⊆ C ∪ inside C)
    (hp : p∈P) (hq : q∈P) (hpC : p∈C) (hqC : q∈C) (hpq : p≠q) :
    ∃ A : Set Plane, IsArcBetween A p q ∧ A∩C={p,q} ∧
      A \ {p,q} ⊆ inside C ∧ Disjoint A K

    (hr : r∈A₁) (hs : s∈A₂) : False

headers.name: scaled_square_interior
square_carrier_proper_arc
headers.header:
theorem square_carrier_proper_arc
    {P K : Set Plane} {p q : Plane}
    (hP : IsCompact P) (hPc : IsPreconnected P) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hPK : Disjoint P K) (hPsq : P ⊆ Plane.closedSquare 0 1)
    (hp : p∈P) (hq : q∈P) (hpq : p≠q) :
    ∃ A : Set Plane, IsPolygonal A ∧ IsArcBetween A p q ∧
      A \ {p,q} ⊆ Plane.openSquare 0 1 ∧ Disjoint A K
